title: Index Maintenance, Bloat & REINDEX CONCURRENTLY
description: Detect index bloat, eliminate unused indexes, and rebuild corrupted indexes without blocking writes using REINDEX CONCURRENTLY.

data.text: Over time, heavy `UPDATE` and `DELETE` cycles cause **index bloat** (empty or sparse B-tree pages that cannot be recycled). Bloated indexes degrade query latency and consume excessive memory in `shared_buffers`.

data.title: Rebuilding Bloated Indexes Online
data.content: Rebuilding indexes without blocking application reads or writes.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Index bloat slows queries by requiring more I/O pages to be traversed.
Use `REINDEX TABLE CONCURRENTLY` in production to defragment indexes without locks.
